summary: Improve client fact-finding, insurer submissions and coverage comparisons with practical insurance broker training. Explore the course outline.
lede: Brokerage work in insurance turns client information into a structured risk profile, an insurer submission and an explainable coverage recommendation. For brokers, client-service staff and broking team leads, the course develops needs analysis, exposure documentation and placement skills, including building risk registers, checking applications, comparing coverage and preparing renewal records.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who gather client risk information, prepare insurance submissions, compare terms or support placement and renewal decisions. It is designed for people who need a clear, documented broking workflow across client, insurer and internal service teams.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with insurance products or client-facing financial services is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use supplied case information and broker document templates.
